hypothesis: Shared-covariance shrinkage discriminants may isolate authorship signal better than logistic regression or the failed v11 RBF probe.

incumbent.note: Recompute fixed historical members on matching outer folds. Do not rerun their grid.

probe.classifier: LinearDiscriminantAnalysis solver=lsqr equal class priors, shrinkage .1 or .5
probe.pooling: row_z(mean of per-layer row_z discriminant scores)

selection: Choose highest development BA; tie prefer shrinkage .1. Evaluate only winner on robustness. Same frozen gates as v11.
limitations: Previously inspected labels and folds; not untouched validation.
Historical Qwen members were selected on all development labels; this optimism affects both comparator and candidate.
